```sql
SELECT
  strftime('%Y-%m', oe.CLOSE_DATE) AS close_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oe.OPPORTUNITY_ID) AS lost_opportunities_count,
  SUM(oe.AMOUNT) AS lost_amount
FROM OFFICE_DW.SALES.OPPORTUNITY_ENHANCED oe
JOIN OFFICE_DW.SFDC.OPPORTUNITY o
  ON oe.OPPORTUNITY_ID = o.ID
WHERE oe.IS_CLOSED = 1
  AND oe.IS_WON = 0
  AND oe.FISCAL_YEAR = 2026
  AND LOWER(o.COMPETITOR_C) LIKE '%splunk%'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', oe.CLOSE_DATE)
ORDER BY close_month;
```
